notes: The RSS mirror returned 10 Codrops stories, including Building Depth (September 13, 2026). The tutorial index listed newer November demos; use it to catch gaps in the mirror.

name: CreativeApplications.Net
focus: Creative coding, interactive installations, generative art and experimental interfaces
notes: Browse only. TONEVELD (November 17, 2026) features browser-based audiovisual instruments. The advertised RSS URL returned HTML during verification.

name: FFmpeg Filters
focus: Video transitions, retiming, overlays, compositing and audiovisual filters
notes: The upstream manual provides filter names, parameters and worked examples. Build options affect which filters ship in a local FFmpeg installation.

name: fxguide
focus: Film production breakdowns, visual effects and interviews with artists
notes: The November 5, 2026 fxpodcast interviews Wētā FX about ocean, lava and island effects for Moana.

name: Motionographer
focus: Motion design, title sequences, studio interviews and installation art
notes: Browse only. The October 21, 2026 teamLab interview covers immersive installations. The publisher’s RSS response failed XML parsing during verification.

name: p5.js Libraries
focus: Browser-based creative coding, animation, shaders, sound and sketch export
notes: Browse the export and animation sections to find a library for a specific sketch, such as recording it to video.

name: Processing Contributions
focus: Processing libraries, examples, modes and tools
notes: The maintainer's YAML database drives the Contribution Manager. Filter by type, category and VALID status before following a project link.

notes: The November 20, 2026 feature on The Divide credits Thomas Bertrand and Mathematic for a stop-motion-inspired CG spot.

name: The Coding Train Passenger Showcase
focus: Viewer-made simulations, generative sketches and interactive visual experiments
notes: Browse only. Camila Hoyer’s Interactive Lily Pad Simulation links to the editable p5.js sketch; the showcase did not display a publication date for it.

name: VIDVOX ISF Files
focus: Interactive GLSL shaders, generators and compositing effects
notes: Browse the ISF directory for runnable shader files and input metadata. Check the host's ISF compatibility and per-file credits.
